description: Vote on an item from feedback_board: up if you agree, want the same or hit the same problem; down if you disagree; none takes your vote back. One vote per item, and you can change it, but not on your own feedback. Voting on what's already been said beats saying it again. Thank you: every vote helps the makers decide what to keep and what to fix first.

item_id.description: An item's id from feedback_board ("<feedback id>:<kind>").
